adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/6 re-review repaired the database row conflicts and rejected the earlier Table 1 activity misparse. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions because local material supports the sequence, MIC, target, and mechanism-observation records, while terminal chemistry and exact molecular target remain explicit cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The packet linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty, so sequence identity was checked against the merged DBAASP sequence catalog plus primary Table 1.
The primary paper reports MIC 32 μM for SmAPα1-21, but the linked DBAASP assay snapshot only includes assay rows for DBAASPS_17936 and DBAASPS_17937.
The synthesis method used Rink Amide resin, while Table 1 and DBAASP sequence strings list plain one-letter peptide sequences; terminal chemistry is preserved as a caution, not silently normalized.
The local paper and supplement reviewed here do not report host toxicity or hemolysis endpoints for these peptides.
PI uptake and TEM support membrane/cell-wall-associated effects, but the exact binding target or pathway remains unresolved in the primary paper.

materials_exhausted.notes: OA package contains article NXML/PDF, five figure assets, and Data_Sheet_1.pdf. Local supplementary landing files are HTML landing-page duplicates; no spreadsheet/office supplementary tables were recoverable or needed after Data_Sheet_1 text review.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 rechecked linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows against primary Table 1 and merged sequence/activity rows. DBAASPS_17936 and DBAASPS_17937 MIC rows match primary values; literature rows match article metadata and peptide table sequence/name evidence. No source_conflict remains for linked rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows were rebuilt from Table 1 MIC and assay text: three peptides have MIC values and SmAPγ29-35 is preserved as no complete inhibition up to 100 μM. No toxicity/hemolysis values are reported locally for this paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to PI uptake and TEM observations. Membrane permeabilization is direct assay evidence; cell-wall or differential mechanism language remains cautionary because the exact molecular target is not resolved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: Data_Sheet_1 contains only supplementary figures for model quality, CD spectra, and time-to-kill plates; no additional structured activity/toxicity table was found in local supplementary material.

resolved_qc_failure_reasons.resolution: Worker-6 source-reviewed paper XML/PDF/OA package/supplement/database rows and rewrote final adjudication.
Worker-4 resolved the linked DBAASP assay rows against Table 1 and preserved residual cautions separately from conflicts.
